test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some bulls are rocks.

Some rocks are stones.

Conclusions:

(I): Some bulls are stones.

(II): All stones are rocks.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some bulls are rocks.

Some rocks are stones.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bdbab6e5d82585fe9c3e2d06ffdbba07ced7cbbf1f99ca93a9cc6c5bdb9f814.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6131ccf060ba390dc0824f3e119ff7cd8d990ca91433739a2c6d0e8a876072a6.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some bulls are stones - **False** (Because, the statements only establish a partial relationship between bulls and rocks, and a partial relationship between rocks and stones. There is no direct or indirect relationship that necessarily implies some bulls are stones)

II. All stones are rocks - **False** (Because, the statement "Some rocks are stones" indicates that only a portion of rocks are stones. It does not imply that all stones belong to the category of rocks. There could be stones that are not rocks.)

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2.**"
